name: Build the iHRIS 5 IG with fhir-harness
documentation: The subprocess of Tool ihris-build-ihris5-ig: the iHRIS 5 IG built from the source its sub-instance pins, and published only on the pages branch. The general steps are fhir-harness's (ig-build-pipeline, ig-publisher-fork, ig-render-jekyll); this diagram is how this folio exercises them. The upstream is never edited: a defect becomes a declared patch the owner decides on.

lanes.name: Build pipeline
lanes.documentation: Runs every step unattended. A step that cannot run says why; it never reports a build it did not make.

lanes.name: Owner
lanes.documentation: Moves the pin, and decides each upstream defect: a declared patch, or wait for the upstream fix.

nodes.name: Pin, patches or build changed, or started by hand
Mount the pinned source
nodes.documentation: Tool ihris-mount-sources: the sub-instance's declared git source at its commit, verified, never committed.

nodes.name: Apply declared patches to a workspace copy
nodes.documentation: Tool ihris-apply-ig-patches. A patch whose text is absent or repeated stops the build: the upstream moved.

nodes.name: Make the IG's packages available
nodes.documentation: Where a package host is refused, seed the cache from trusted sources (fhir-harness Tool fhir-cache-seed-npm, with the owner's mirror). A version no source carries is MISSING, never substituted in a build that publishes.

nodes.name: One Publisher build, writing the AST
nodes.documentation: fhir-harness Tool ig-ast-export: SUSHI, then one ordinary IG Publisher build, then the AST beside output/.

nodes.name: Index, artefact pages and the IG's own narrative, in just-the-docs
nodes.documentation: The artefact index from the AST, the menu from sushi-config, the pages in IG-site mode, composed into the platform chrome scoped to this folio.

nodes.name: Publish to the pages branch
nodes.documentation: Only on the pages branch: the folio's IG route, or a change proposal's staging preview. Never committed to the source branch.

nodes.name: Decide the upstream defect: declared patch or upstream fix
nodes.documentation: A defect in the IG's own source is reported upstream; a declared patch, with its reason, is how the folio builds meanwhile. Only the owner decides.

nodes.name: Not published; the blocker is stated

flows.name: no: a defect in the IG source
